items.title: Space stocks fall below their 52-week highs as SpaceX sinks lower
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at the space industry, including SpaceX (SPCX) which has sunk below its IPO price, and examines how top space stocks are off their 52-week highs.

items.title: Could AMD's new Helios AI rack system push it to outperform Nvidia?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) unveiled its latest AI infrastructure product, the Helios rackscale systems for data centers. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines AMD's latest raft of microprocessors and other products that aim to put it in direct competition with chip competitor Nvidia (NVDA). AMD is currently scheduled to report second quarter earnings on Tuesday, August 4, well ahead of Nvidia's earnings release expected out on Wednesday, August 26.

items.title: The Hidden Volatility Brewing Inside Intuit Stock
items.summary: If you hold shares in the tax software giant, the market is pricing a future that could look radically different a year from now, and you already own that risk.

items.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
items.summary: AI companies, including Nvidia and Mistral, urge policymakers to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight AI models as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI and alleged model distillation.

items.title: The Balance Sheet Boondoggle at Alphabet is Exactly Why I’m Buying Over and Over
items.summary: Alphabet posted its strongest quarter ever, then watched the stock crater 7% as the market panicked over a balance sheet move that looks less like weakness and more like a calculated bet on where AI revenue lands a decade from now.

items.title: IREN Vs Nebius: Which Neocloud Should You Buy and Why?
items.summary: Two neoclouds are racing for the same gigawatts and hyperscaler contracts, but one bets on owned dirt while the other bets on a full software stack. Only one of those bets looks defensible heading into 2026.
